scope: One independent serial start and one loaded discovery start per action. Shared prompts remove input-distribution differences. P service starts at worker acceptance. D service starts at worker acceptance after coordinator admission. These are host envelopes, not GPU-exclusive time. Serial and online scheduling, ownership and overlap differ. A difference does not distinguish GPU bandwidth interference from host/control work without another intervention. This audit does not refit the frozen cost model or use these outcomes in an online controller.
